# DreamLab

> DreamLab is an Applied Innovation Lab in the UK Lake District. Teams co-create
> with 44+ deep tech specialists across AI, immersive XR, cyber trust and
> creative technology through residential programmes, embedded R&D residencies
> and free self-guided courses. Primary calls to action: explore programmes at
> /programmes or book a discovery call via /contact (info@dreamlab-ai.com).

DreamLab serves enterprise and SME teams. The site is a React single-page
application; a Nostr-based community forum lives at /community/ and a retro
BBS client at /community/bbs/.

## Core pages

- [Programmes](https://dreamlab-ai.com/programmes): Residential deep tech training programmes for enterprise and SME teams
- [Co-Create](https://dreamlab-ai.com/co-create): Embedded R&D sprints and co-creation residencies at the Lake District facility
- [Research](https://dreamlab-ai.com/research): Research output, system design work and demonstration videos
- [Ecosystem](https://dreamlab-ai.com/ecosystem): The open-source VisionFlow ecosystem DreamLab builds and operates
- [Team](https://dreamlab-ai.com/team): The 44+ specialist network with biographies
- [Contact](https://dreamlab-ai.com/contact): Enquiries and discovery-call booking (E2E-encrypted form)

## Self-guided courses

- [Workshop index](https://dreamlab-ai.com/workshops): Free 9-phase, 51+ hour AI-powered knowledge work curriculum — foundations, AI APIs, Claude Code, local AI and RAG, Docker, AI agents and orchestration, QA and publishing
- [Testimonials](https://dreamlab-ai.com/testimonials): Client and participant feedback

## Optional

- [Ventures](https://dreamlab-ai.com/ventures): Venture-building activity
- [Privacy](https://dreamlab-ai.com/privacy): Privacy policy (no-database, E2E-encrypted contact ingress)
- [Community forum](https://dreamlab-ai.com/community/): Nostr-based community forum
